instruction: Refer to vcarve_sign.step, vcarve_text.svg. Open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits when working on `vcarve_sign.step`. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM V-Carve operation. Use the SVG closed double-line OPEN text, keep its center position unchanged, and carve it into the top face with a maximum depth of 2 mm using the 60 degree V-bit. T1 is a 60 degree V-bit for the V-Carve OPEN text. Set the T1 ToolController label to exactly T1_60DEG_VBIT so the posted NC preserves the required tool-angle metadata. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-17.nc.
